title: Deterministic instruction extraction
statement: Let $A$ be a memory-augmented register program, let $l$ be one of its control states, and let $i$ be a register instruction. If the instruction of $A$ at $l$ is $i$, then for either Boolean parameter $\beta$, the deterministic part of $A$ at $l$ is $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ at $l$ equals $i$ as a deterministic instruction
